home: “Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth.”
God’s Word is the foundation of truth.
Stand strong in the Lord and put on the whole armor of God.
Seek first the kingdom of God and His righteousness.
about: Declare the works of the Lord to the generations that follow.
“Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.”
The Lord’s mercy and truth endure through all generations.
beliefs: Scripture is God-inspired and equips believers for good works.
“In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.”
The divine Word is central to our faith.
God’s Word is living, powerful, and discerning.
vision: Vision must remain connected to God’s revealed instruction.
Write the vision plainly and remain faithful in waiting.
Make disciples and teach the commands of Christ.
ministries: Ministry gifts equip the saints for the work of ministry.
Different gifts serve the body through the same Spirit.
Use the gifts you have received to serve one another.
events: Gather together and encourage one another toward love and good works.
Jesus speaks of His presence where believers gather in His name.
“I was glad when they said unto me, Let us go into the house of the LORD.”
Gathering for worship is a joy.
sermons: “So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.”
Faith grows through hearing God’s Word.
Put the Word into practice, rather than only listening.
visit: Welcome one another as Christ has welcomed us.
Enter His gates with thanksgiving and praise.
Remember to show hospitality to others.
giving: The Lord addresses bringing tithes into the storehouse.
Honor the Lord with your substance and firstfruits.
Give willingly and cheerfully, not under compulsion.
contact: Bring your requests to God with prayer and thanksgiving.
Pray with confidence according to God’s will.
